title: TCP, UDP, DCCP: Fix follow conversation filter with tunneling
description:
This fixes the stream selection in the filter, and doesn't rely on
the last port settings being the same as the protocol being followed.
It finds the last case of TCP or UDP (or DCCP) in the packet, but now
works for following UDP even when the UDP has TCP or ICMP tunnelled
inside, like with GTP-U.

For cases where multiple TCP or UDP streams are in the same packet,
the follow listener may still need to check the stream to see if it
matches the one intended.

Ping #18231
